bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
work="$repo/.worktrees/link-pr55-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = eca68464881ec4b26dc399f6c7323153232e2696
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
echo "PR55_DEPLOY_PRECHECK"
docker image inspect --format 'CANDIDATE={{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr55-eca6846
docker inspect --format 'LIVE={{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
printf 'INLINE_SUPPORT='
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p="/run/secrets/bot_token";const token=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8").trim(); const c=new AbortController();setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),12000);fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/getMe",{signal:c.signal}).then(r=>r.json()).then(x=>{if(!x.ok||!x.result){console.log("BOT_GETME_FAILED");process.exitCode=2;}else{console.log(x.result.supports_inline_queries===true?"ENABLED":"DISABLED");console.log("BOT_ID="+x.result.id)}}).catch(()=>{console.log("BOT_GETME_NETWORK_FAIL");process.exitCode=2})'
echo DB_LINK_SCHEMA_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='link_button_posts' ORDER BY ordinal_position" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_QUERY_FAILED
echo DB_LINK_SCHEMA_END
echo DEPLOY_PRECHECK_END
